apps/api/views_marketplace_catalog.py.notes: Marketplace catalog and scopes endpoints intentionally expose cacheable public developer-directory metadata without tenant secrets or installation data.

apps/api/views_webhook_catalog.py.notes: Webhook event type catalog intentionally exposes cacheable public integration metadata without tenant webhook subscriptions, secrets, or deliveries.

apps/migration_cloud/api/docs.py.notes: Spectacular schema + Redoc mounts are public-readable; authenticated tokens still required for API calls.

apps/schools/api_views.py.notes: SchoolConfigAPI exposes host-resolved branding and offline capability to SPA/mobile clients without authentication.

apps/accounts/views_saml.py.notes: SAML ACS callback accepts IdP POST without browser session CSRF token.

apps/api/br_northstar_views.py.notes: Internal JSON APIs for BR north-star; called from control plane with session or Bearer.

apps/api/lead_capture_api.py.notes: Public lead capture; rate limiting + audit logging (lead_capture_created/lead_capture_duplicate).

apps/api/learning_institution_api.py.notes: Learning pack install + pack rollback (ROLLBACK keyword); session staff + school context.

apps/api/north_star_api_views.py.notes: Event catalog, wedge playbook, RUM web vitals summary (staff), upcoming deadlines (N28), package-impact internal JSON.

apps/api/oidc_rp.py.notes: OIDC RP callback accepts IdP POST without browser CSRF token.

apps/api/oneroster.py.notes: OneRoster v1.2 users bulk POST (v4.00.83); Idempotency-Key + Bearer auth; 207 per-row semantics.

apps/api/oneroster_csv_importer.py.notes: OneRoster CSV bulk import API; machine client Bearer auth.

apps/api/oneroster_demographics.py.notes: OneRoster v1.2 Demographics POST/PUT write endpoints (v4.00.60); machine Bearer auth.

apps/api/oneroster_oauth2_introspection..notes: RFC 7662 token introspection; caller Bearer auth required; machine OAuth client surface.

apps/api/oneroster_oauth2_token.py.notes: RFC 6749 client_credentials token endpoint for OneRoster v1.2 OAuth; no browser session CSRF.

apps/api/oneroster_results.py.notes: OneRoster grade/results/classGroup API surface; machine client Bearer auth (v4.00.57 classGroup dispatch + bulk delete).

apps/api/oneroster_roster_webhook.py.notes: OneRoster roster webhook (school-scoped secret) + platform marketplace integration webhook (RuntimeDefaults.webhook_signing_secret; X-RunMyCampus-Integration-Signature; PlatformIntegrationWebhookEvent audit).

apps/api/oneroster_writes.py.notes: OneRoster roster mutation endpoints; machine client Bearer auth.

apps/api/saml.py.notes: SAML SP ACS + IdP SLO POST (sls_idp) + SP-initiated SLO start/callback + SP-initiated SSO login_start (v4.00.67); IdP/browser POST without CSRF.

apps/api/scim.py.notes: Bearer-token SCIM v2 provisioning under apps/api/scim.py.

apps/api/scim_views.py.notes: Bearer-token SCIM provisioning mutation and detail endpoints.

apps/apicenter/oauth_views.py.notes: OAuth token endpoint accepts external non-browser client credential, authorization code, and refresh token POSTs without a browser CSRF token; guarded by client secret verification, single-use authorization codes, and refresh-token rotation.

apps/billing/views_embedded_checkout.py.notes: Anonymous parent checkout session endpoint accepts JSON from tenant marketing or parent portal without a browser CSRF token; tenant id is cross-checked against request.school when present and payload is schema-validated before PSP dispatch.

apps/communication/views_sms_inbound_web.notes: Two endpoints (inbound MO + status callback): SMS providers POST without browser CSRF. Every request is verified by _signature_ok() — a valid Twilio X-Twilio-Signature HMAC-SHA1 (constant-time compare) wins, else a valid Africa's Talking shared secret (AT has no request-signing scheme); bad signature -> 403, never 5xx.

apps/communication/views_whatsapp_webhoo.notes: Meta WhatsApp webhook must accept provider GET/POST callbacks without browser CSRF; GET verification and POST delivery are guarded by integration verification, tenant feature flag gating, and hashed-phone logging.

apps/integrations_marketplace/webhooks.p.notes: Inbound connector webhook receiver; per-integration + per-IP rate limit before HMAC verify; school scoped via ServiceIntegration row.

apps/migration_cloud/companion_receiver..notes: Companion browser extension upload/sign endpoints; CSRF exempt for extension POST; MAA + ciphertext integrity guards.

apps/migration_cloud/views_guardian_cons.notes: Anonymous guardian consent accept/decline/revoke POSTs use a 256-bit URL token as the credential; responses are uniform for probe resistance, cache-disabled, clickjack-protected, and decision state prevents replay.

apps/observability/views_friction.py.notes: Friction UX ingest POST from same-origin recorder; requires authenticated user or school on request; payload capped; anonymous returns ignored no-op.

apps/orchestration/api.py.notes: Orchestration runs JSON API; csrf_exempt for JWT/API clients; tenant filter on non-staff; cancel/retry/create guarded by _can_act.

apps/platform_runtime/views_newsletter.p.notes: Two endpoints: (1) public newsletter subscribe POST from marketing/portal without browser CSRF (double opt-in service handles abuse); (2) RFC 8058 one-click List-Unsubscribe-Post — mail clients POST without a CSRF token and the opaque per-recipient token in the URL is the authenticator.

apps/platform_runtime/views_rum.py.notes: RUM POST; token in JSON body for sendBeacon; PlatformEventLog rum_web_vitals.

apps/portal/views_office.py.notes: WOPI endpoints accept Collabora server callbacks without CSRF; guarded by document-scoped HMAC token and auth context.

apps/schoolops/views_email_webhook.py.notes: Email provider bounce webhook must accept external POSTs without browser CSRF; provider-specific HMAC/signature checks run before JSON parsing, request bodies are capped, and recipient addresses are hashed before logging.

apps/schools/lti_tool_token.py.notes: LTI 1.3 tool token endpoint (RFC 6749 client_credentials + JWT bearer assertion); machine client POST without browser CSRF.

apps/schools/section8_views.py.notes: Cross-origin LTI callback and service endpoints that still accept external tool traffic.

apps/security/csp_report_view.py.notes: CSP violation reports are browser-generated POSTs without application CSRF cookies; the endpoint rate-limits, caps request bodies, and logs only normalized directive and URI metadata.

apps/setup_studio/views_wizard_cache_tel.notes: Wizard localStorage cache telemetry beacon (204 no-content); sendBeacon POST without CSRF; event allowlist only.

config/graphql_view.py.notes: GraphQL gateway POST/GET; IP throttle; staff-only school registry; query-only schema; CSRF exempt for API clients.

apps/accounts/legacy_hashes/key_rotation.reason: Operational key-rotation helper builds a field update for selected encrypted columns only; tenant-wide operation is explicitly audited and limited to ops key rotation.

apps/analytics/management/commands/migra.reason: Staff-run pgvector migration command performs extension/vector DDL and bounded batch backfill that has no ORM equivalent.

apps/analytics/management/commands/rebui.reason: Staff-run pgvector maintenance command checks catalog state and rebuilds IVFFLAT index/VACUUM ANALYZE with controlled constants.

apps/analytics/management/commands/verif.reason: Read-only PostgreSQL extension readiness probe for pgvector; operator verification command only.
Read-only pgvector readiness and index diagnostics use pg_catalog, EXPLAIN, and row-count probes unavailable through ORM.

apps/analytics/semantic_search.py.reason: Vector similarity query uses pgvector distance operator with parameterized query and bounded result limit.

apps/migration_cloud/intake/access_intak.reason: Offline Microsoft Access intake reads a selected table through the pyodbc cursor API after source-file validation; not Django database SQL.

apps/migration_cloud/intake/sql_dump_int.reason: Offline SQLite dump intake enumerates local import tables and materializes CSV payloads using quoted identifiers; not Django production SQL.

apps/migration_cloud/management/commands.reason: Pre-approved migration-cloud purge command deletes by tenant hash and cutoff inside an atomic block with explicit operator approval flow.
Audit-chain repair path rewrites hash linkage for a verified event row during operator verification; append-only exception is explicit and logged.

apps/people/repositories/audit_repositor.reason: Section 2.4 Audit DDL: set_search_path, create_audit_trigger_function, drop_audit_trigger, create_audit_trigger, revoke_audit_log_mutations; staff-only.

apps/people/schema_repair.py.reason: Schema repair DDL/backfill adds and enforces one timestamp column using quoted identifiers during controlled startup repair.

apps/platform_runtime/sqlite_pragmas.py.reason: SQLite connection_created hook sets PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL and synchronous=NORMAL on file-backed dev/test DBs only; no user input; reduces test lock contention.

apps/portal/kb_pgvector.py.reason: Knowledge-base pgvector adapter uses read-only schema introspection plus parameterized vector similarity search with school filter.

apps/portal/management/commands/migrate_.reason: Staff-run portal KB pgvector migration performs extension/vector DDL, batch backfill, index creation, and dimension detection.

apps/schools/repositories/health_reposit.reason: Section 2.4 Tenant health PG catalog plus count_table_rows for tenant_health_check; schema filtering is done inline without SET search_path leakage; staff-only; tested.

apps/schools/repositories/rls_context_re.reason: Section 2.4 RLS session SET/RESET for app.current_school_id and app.rls_bypass; no ORM; consumed from schools/rls_context.

apps/schools/repositories/rls_repository.reason: Section 2.4 RLS verification: single SELECT on pg_class and pg_namespace for verify_tenant_rls.

apps/schools/rls_readiness.py.reason: RLS readiness preflight verifies PostgreSQL GUC support and pg_policies catalog state; read-only except SET/RESET session variable.

apps/siteconfig/repositories/database_re.reason: Section 2.4 SQLite PRAGMA integrity_check for recover_database command; staff-only.

apps/siteconfig/repositories/rls_session.reason: Section 2.4 Read-only PostgreSQL GUC app.current_school_id via current_setting(..., true) for tenant cache prefix; no ORM equivalent; consumed from cache_utils.
